duel.compared_scope: Declared game fields, whole SRAM and RNG cursor0; flags/registers/stack/mapper/display effects explicitly excluded
duel.oracle_scope: Actual unmodified ROM instructions and all called helpers; CPU-only bus with explicit IO assumptions, not a full video-frame test

postbattle.scope: Independent high-level gameplay source versus original-ROM CPU oracle; full SRAM plus declared gameplay buffers/state. CPU scratch/flags/bank-register and UI queue encodings are not promised.

services.scope: All registers/flags/SP/PC, complete RAM/SRAM and physical PRG mapper windows; explicit source services
limits: PPU/audio synthesis and queue completion are not executed. Requests retain original queued state.
D flag is clear as in this NES game. Rejection bound0 cannot terminate and is excluded.
Menus use bounded, terminated matrix fixtures; not arbitrary corrupted pointer data.

terrain.scope: Original6502 code oracle with synthetic RAM; external drawing/input/far helpers execute original ROM explicitly. Complete-core menu screenshots are separately labeled synthetic fixtures.

limits: Legal control-table coverage, executed instruction coverage, semantic-field equivalence and full NES frames are separate scopes.
